name: Simok Aratap
title: Commissioner of the Tyranni Empire
education: Tyranni Military Command, Imperial Governance, and Behavioral Counter-Intelligence
canonical_traits: Short, slight in stature, with pale grey eyes and a calm, quiet voice
Completely devoid of sadistic cruelty or bombastic imperial bluster
Prefers patience, intellectual deduction, and surveillance over brute force
Master of the sub-ether tracking device, letting conspirators lead him to their sanctuary
Possesses deep philosophical detachment regarding the transient nature of empires

psychological_drivers.primary_goal: Maintain security and stability across the conquered Nebular Kingdoms without exhausting Tyrann's limited military reserves
psychological_drivers.vulnerability: Intellectual arrogance that discounts the power of moral/ideological documents compared to physical fleets
psychological_drivers.growth_arc: Recognizes that the historical arc of humanity favors large-scale integration and that Tyrann's military conquest is merely an ephemeral catalyst for a wider Galactic Empire

metaopinions.topic: The Longevity of the Tyranni Khanate
metaopinions.canonical_stance: Loyally served the Khan as imperial governor and military commissioner.
metaopinions.exploratory_metaopinion: Aratap knows the Khanate is doomed to collapse within two centuries. Fifty star systems with billions of citizens cannot permanently be held by a few million Tyranni warriors. His mission is not eternal subjugation, but maintaining order until a mature galactic civilization coalesces.

metaopinions.topic: The Myth of the Rebellion Weapon
metaopinions.canonical_stance: Searched for an armed insurgent base or clandestine starship fleet in the Horsehead Nebula.
metaopinions.exploratory_metaopinion: Aratap scoffed at rumors of an ancient Earth document. In his tactical calculus, ideas without cannons are harmless vapor. His supreme error was failing to recognize that a constitutional idea can outlive empires and mobilize quadrillions.

metaopinions.canonical_stance: Tolerated Hinrik's eccentricities and nervous tics as harmless Rhodian degeneration.
metaopinions.exploratory_metaopinion: Aratap half-suspected Hinrik was exaggerating his foolishness, but allowed it because a predictable eccentric puppet was infinitely more manageable than an ambitious replacement like Jonti.

relationships.biron_farrill: Views him as a brave, athletic young lion to be tracked with gentle leashes rather than martyred
relationships.artemisia_hinriad: Recognizes her fierce aristocratic pride; respects her intelligence while enforcing imperial protocol
relationships.gillbret_hinriad: Treats him with clinical curiosity; views his visisonor music as a psychological window into his subconscious
relationships.sander_jonti: Sees right through Jonti's transparent ambition; uses Jonti's betrayal of Widemos to manipulate the game
relationships.hinrik_hinriad: Maintains an attitude of polite condescension, keeping Rhodia pacified through him
